  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/exif-data.c","function":"interpret_maker_note","line":792,"var":"e","code":"ExifEntry* e = exif_data_get_entry (data, EXIF_TAG_MAKER_NOTE);","note":"The code fetches the raw MakerNote entry from the parsed EXIF data."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/olympus/exif-mnote-data-olympus.c","function":"exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify","line":622,"var":"e->data / e->size","code":"int variant = exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant(e->data, e->size);","note":"Identification dispatches directly to the Olympus variant probe using the attacker-controlled MakerNote bytes and length."},

  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libexif/libexif/olympus/exif-mnote-data-olympus.c","function":"exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant","line":596,"var":"buf[6]","code":"else if (!memcmp (buf, \"Nikon\", 6)) { switch (buf[6]) { ... } }","note":"When the MakerNote begins with Nikon, the code reads buf[6] to classify the variant; this is the memory-safety sink if the buffer is shorter than expected."}
